salary.promotionHelpRank1:
• Provide three examples of meaningful protocol contributions.
  • Actively design a deployable or future protocol component at PRP² standards.
  • Assist in analysis, formalization, or implementation at peer-reviewed or PRP standards.
  • Know Polkadot’s key goals and principles.
  • Examples: fixing key issues, enabling network fixes, proposing innovations, or improving protocol design.
salary.promotionHelpRank2:
• Lead formalization, implementation, or analysis of a major protocol component, with peer-reviewed publication or justified exception.
  • Publish at least one long-form semi-technical article on Polkadot.
salary.promotionHelpRank3:
• In-person review on contributions.
  • Defend Polkadot's role confidently.
  • Advocate via articles, social media, or events.
  • Share knowledge: forums, talks, or platforms.
  • Lead protocol design or implementation with review or deployment.
salary.promotionHelpRank4:
• Play a key role in creating and formalizing a major protocol component, with formalization in a peer-reviewed publication or deployment in the protocol after expert code review.
  • Promote or defend Polkadot outside the ecosystem through a public presentation or notable media (e.g., journal or news).
salary.promotionHelpRank5:
• Publish a long-form article on relevant technology beyond Polkadot.
  • Lead ideation, design, and formalization or prototyping of a major component.
  • Contribute to the creation of three other major components.
  • Assist in shaping the long-term technical roadmap through advocacy, research, or analysis.
salary.promotionHelpRank6:
• Lead the design and implementation of a major protocol innovation.
  • Publish at least three long-form articles on relevant technology beyond Polkadot.
  • Discuss: What have you learnt from this individual which you might ultimately find useful in your efforts to help Polkadot succeed?
salary.promotionHelpRank7:
• Deepened understanding of Polkadot’s philosophy through discussion, literature parallels, or expert discourse.
  • Delivered major presentations on Polkadot to peers from other ecosystems or industries.
  • Discuss: Does the wider academic community or industry tend to learn from this individual (even if the individual did not discover this knowledge themselves)?
salary.promotionHelpRank8:
• Publish a canonical article on Polkadot’s philosophical principles.
  • Publish an industry-recognized article on a relevant innovation beyond Polkadot.
  • Be widely recognized as an intellectual leader beyond the Polkadot ecosystem.
  • Discuss: How did this individual's idea or invention become adopted in the wider academic community or industry?
salary.promotionHelpRank9:
• Generally recognised as a philosophical, social, artistic, political and/or technological heavyweight outside of blockchain or crypto.
  • Discuss: what outstanding service did the individual provide to the Polkadot network?

voting.aboutVoting:
Voting

In the Polkadot OpenGov voting system, there are three types of votes:

  • Aye vote - a vote "for" a proposal. Votes are counted with a conviction multiplier that increases the number of votes based on the voter's conviction.
  • Nay vote - a vote "against." Similar to the aye vote, it considers the level of conviction, multiplying the number of votes.
  • Abstain vote - abstaining from voting. Abstain votes do not affect the conviction level and are not counted in the vote tally with conviction.
voting.aboutVotingPower:
Voting power and lock period

Conviction is a mechanism that allows participants to amplify their vote by locking their tokens for various periods (lock period). The longer the tokens are locked, the stronger the vote. For example, a six-times conviction increases the vote's weight and requires a token lock for 32 weeks after voting ends.

pureProxyTooltip.description1: A Pure Proxy is an account that you can create using one of your existing accounts. Pure Proxies can only carry out transactions when another account instructs it to. When you create a Pure Proxy the account that created it is automatically given the "Any" Delegated Authority access type meaning it can instruct the Pure Proxy to carry out any transaction, this can be changed once the Pure Proxy is created.
pureProxyTooltip.description2:
Pure Proxies provide additional account management features such as:
  • Enhanced Security: They cannot be stolen because they do not have a private key.
  • Simplified and Secure Account Management: Pure Proxies can help to simplify the management of complex account relationships
  • Multisig Account Management: Using a Pure Proxy makes it easier to change multisig signatories that can control your assets as a delegated authority.
